answer.justification: lr(t) is constant for t > 50, so after step 50 nothing the warmup schedule does can move the ratio. Confirmed by the no-warmup control arm converging to the warmup arm.
answer.caveat: control convergence is noisier than the schedule argument because the two arms have different weight trajectories by step 50, so their ratios need not match to tight tolerance even at identical lr. The schedule argument is the clean answer.
